description: Mozilla-branded Cloudflare DoH endpoint used by Firefox TRR.
fbcdn.net media/static CDN (the messenger nettest's xx.fbcdn.net hosts stay on facebook_messenger/*).
facebook.com. Messenger-specific endpoints under it are mapped separately (facebook_messenger/*).
translate.goog translated-page proxy, a de-facto circumvention path.
Mozilla DoH canary domain: an NXDOMAIN here tells Firefox to disable DoH, so networks answer it deliberately. Not a browsable service.
Cisco OpenDNS resolver (doh.opendns.com); the marketing site stays on opendns.com.
Signal's main chat service. chat.signal.org today, textsecure-service.whispersystems.org historically.
Contact discovery. cdsi.signal.org today, api.directory.signal.org historically.
signal.org; the app endpoints under it stay on signal/* via exact/pattern.
Telegram datacentre access points, probed by IP. They are redundant fallbacks, so the app works if any one is reachable.
The eN.whatsapp.net server pool. The spec treats WhatsApp as blocked only when every endpoint in the pool fails.
whatsapp.net media/upload hosts (mmg, pps, media.*); the e<N> chat pool stays on whatsapp/endpoints via pattern.
whatsapp.com marketing site; web.whatsapp.com stays on whatsapp/web.
googlevideo.com video delivery; blocking it breaks playback while youtube.com still loads.
